scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; production code read line by line, tests skimmed; tripwire, overlap and apply-vs-main triage used
findings: Adds LoadPackagedLibrary, AddDllDirectory/RemoveDllDirectory and SetDefaultDllDirectories shims in runtime/shims/library_loader.cpp plus resolve helpers in file_system.cpp. LoadPackagedLibrary rejects absolute paths, drive colons, '..' and any directory separator, then only loads shim or bundled modules (no arbitrary LoadLibrary by path).
Tripwire LoadLibraryW(version.dll) is in runtime/test/loader_test.cpp (test using a system DLL) and is a false positive.

Behavior note: AddDllDirectory now registers overlay and bundled game directories into the real process DLL search path, so a DLL placed in the user's overlay folder becomes loadable by the game; this is the intended feature on the user's own machine. No overlap, applies cleanly.
